{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')
# Drop rows where body_mass_g is missing
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f'Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
